, and its first freestanding Gallery in the world. Previewed at RH Milan during Salone del Mobile and introduced with the opening of RH London, RH Estates will significantly expand its retail presence across the globe this year, followed by a second freestanding RH Estates Gallery on Melrose Avenue in Los Angeles opening in 2027.
